Web search (two queries) returned the Nario-Redmond 2017 abstract text: Exp 2 (N=50) 'participants judged themselves less competent, expressed more pity, expressed more interaction discomfort... not more willing to interview disabled students'; both experiments: more confused, embarrassed, helpless.

Web search confirmed WCAG 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold is a Level A criterion (no more than three flashes in any one second, or below general and red flash thresholds); W3C Understanding page URL listed in results; w3.org fetch blocked so the page itself was not opened

Verifier round 3 start: ran brief M03; output perspective-engine/ethics/irb-packet.md (242 lines, v0.3) present; summary at top is 147 words (limit 150)

Input-consistency: 80-150/target 120/24 teams of ~5, CI half-width 0.36-0.50 SD, T2 day 30 (25-35), T3 day 56, burden 12/8/12 min, intensity 0.5/0.8, 10-item AAI, >=3 direct reports, n<10 suppression, stop rule wording all match preregistration.md (V03): PASS

Input-consistency: hold-until-holder-agrees-or-majority-lifts, first content review only once debrief draft exists (advisory-board.md V04); Nario-Redmond critical reviewer, double-empathy ADHD extrapolation and Edinburgh 'Limit' (partners.md V15): PASS

Web spot-check 1: Nario-Redmond et al. 2017 abstract via search (PubMed fetch blocked by proxy): Exp1 N=60, Exp2 N=50; both experiments more confused, embarrassed, helpless; Exp2 only more pity and interaction discomfort, not more willing to interview. Packet sec 0, consent 1, sec 7 match: PASS

Web spot-check 2: WCAG 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold is Level A, no flashing >3 times/sec or below general and red flash thresholds; W3C WCAG22 Understanding URL cited in packet appears in results: PASS
Acceptance: consent form present (3.1 manager form with risks, voluntariness, two withdrawal options, data handling, understanding check; 3.2 process; 3.3 site; 3.4 direct-report sheet): PASS

Acceptance: debrief present (4.1 T-arm D1-D8, 4.2 C-arm, 4.3 end-of-study, 4.4 direct-report, 4.5 D4 strengths rule); summary now states D4 is empty and no debrief yet meets the strengths standard, consistent with 4.5: PASS
Acceptance: adverse-event handling present (5.1 levels incl. data incident, 5.2 safeguards, 5.3 stop rules matching V03 plus proposed additions, 5.4 contacts, 5.5 records): PASS

Role card: every number traces to V03/V04/V15 or the two cited web sources, or is marked placeholder/proposal/unverified (7/10 distress, 1 working day, GDPR 72h); no 'simulate ADHD'/'what ADHD is like' claim except negations and the sec 9 flag list; nothing sent, no contact, git shows no outbound ac

Prior-round gaps re-checked: pity now attributed to Exp 2 in sec 0, consent 1, sec 7; summary no longer overstates D4; WCAG 2.3.1 has W3C source and unverified version note; s1 cites 4.1; no 'treat colleagues' overclaim: all FIXED

Non-blocking for advisors: D1 line 'Those reactions are common' is an unsourced frequency claim and sits oddly with consent s5 'We do not know how likely any of this is'; consider 'Some people feel...'
done: IRB packet v0.3 verified: consent, debrief, AE handling present; Nario-Redmond and WCAG 2.3.1 citations confirmed; nothing sent
